tool.name: Promoter Motif Scanner
tool.description: scan for -35 and -10 sigma70 motif candidates
tool.command: #set $reverse_arg = "--scan-reverse-complement" if str($scan_reverse_complement) == "true" else "" #set $simple_args = "" #set $fimo_args = "" #if str($scanner.mode) == "simple": #set $simple_args = "--minus35-consensus '%s' --minus10-consensus '%s'" % ($scanner.minus35_consensus, $scanner.minus10_consensus) #if str($scanner.minus35_meme) not in ["", "None"]: #set $simple_args = $simple_args + " --minus35-meme '%s'" % $scanner.minus35_meme #end if #if str($scanner.minus10_meme) not in ["", "None"]: #set $simple_args = $simple_args + " --minus10-meme '%s'" % $scanner.minus10_meme #end if #else: #set $fimo_args = "--meme-file '%s' --fimo-binary '%s'" % ($scanner.meme_file, $scanner.fimo_binary) #end if \${PROMOTER_TOOLS_PYTHON:-python} '$__tool_directory__/promoter_motif_scanner.py' --input-fasta '$input_fasta' --output-tsv 'motif_hits.tsv' --log 'run_log.txt' --mode '$scanner.mode' $simple_args $fimo_args $reverse_arg

param.name: meme_file
param.label: Combined MEME motif file for FIMO mode

param.name: fimo_binary
param.label: FIMO executable
param.help: Use PATH default when the promoter_tools conda environment is configured in job_conf.yml.

tool.help: Scan promoter sequences for -35 and -10 candidates. Simple mode uses consensus matching or MEME PWM files. FIMO mode requires MEME Suite to be installed.
